category_edits.rationale: Cap effective item embedding norms at 0.75 to test whether stronger norm control improves generalization across all four datasets. The shared item_embeddings method applies this cap to histories, positive/negative targets, and prediction candidates while preserving zero padding, dimensions, and tying. The generated predictor imports this SASRec class, so inference uses the same normalization automatically.

change_summary: Tighten the shared item embedding norm cap from 1.0 to 0.75; preserve all other training and inference behavior.
